newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers buys ice rink complex.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers buys ice rink complex.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc said it bought Incredible Ice, an ice skating facility operator.
The company, which owns the Florida Panthers hockey team, said it will issue 212,766 shares of class A common shares and $1 million cash, and assume $8 million in construction debt.
Incredible Ice's first facility is in Coral Springs, Fla., Florida Panthers said in a release. It includes two ice rinks and associated retail, food and beverage operations.

Richard Evans, Panthers president and chief executive officer said "Incredible Ice is uniquely positioned to take advantage of the tremendous interest in South Florida for ice-based sports and recreation and to regionally connect amateur league programs in hockey and figure skating, which is an important step in making these exciting sports more accessible. This company is an ideal complement to the Florida Panthers and the Broward County Arena, (which is) scheduled to open in the Fall of 1998."
